Dimasa Kingdom.question: The kingdom's agrarian base included settled wet-rice cultivation in the fertile riverine tracts of central and eastern _____
Dimasa Kingdom.fact: The Dimasa Kingdom also called Kachari kingdom was a late medieval/early modern kingdom in Assam, Northeast India ruled by Dimasa kings. The Dimasa kingdom and others (Kamata, Chutiya) that developed in the wake of the Kamarupa kingdom were examples of new states that emerged from indigenous communities in medieval Assam as a result of socio-political transformations in these communities.
